description: Split a URL into protocol, user, host, port, path, query, fragment and origin (with decoded forms), list its query parameters in order (duplicates and bare flags kept, + as space) and flag tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, mc_cid, _ga, _hsenc…). Optionally returns the URL with tracking removed. A missing scheme means https://. Passwords are never echoed. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/url-toolkit/

stripTracking.description: Also return "cleanUrl" with tracking parameters removed.

name: url_parse
title: URL parse
